name: clawd-buddy
description: Clawd lives above your prompt: he locks in while Claude works, chills when it goes quiet, celebrates a long turn and hops when you talk to him. Under him, a context forecast and what is left of your 5-hour and weekly limits, a prompt cache countdown, a live context view and compaction controls, in the band or a sidebar. In the terminal and the desktop app. An unofficial fan mod, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.

desktopSize.title: Clawd's size in the desktop app
desktopSize.description: CSS pixels for each of his sprite pixels. Whole numbers draw sharpest. The terminal draws him in half blocks either way.

multiplyRemoteControl.title: Start /multiply clones with remote control
multiplyRemoteControl.description: Windows only. On: each clone /multiply opens runs `claude --remote-control`, so you can reach it from claude.ai or your phone. Off: plain `claude`.
